item.title: Roma eyeing Kevin Santos, Nusa and Kvernadze for January
item.description: Roma eyeing Kevin Santos, Nusa and Kvernadze for January Roma is working to strengthen its attack ahead of the winter transfer window. According to Calciomercato.it , the Giallorossi management has identified three players to strengthen Gian Piero Gasperini’s wingers. Sporting director D’Amico has reportedly already initiated contact with Kevin Santos Lopes de Macedo, Antonio Nusa, and Giorgi Kvernadze. The former, born in 2003, is a left winger currently owned by Fulham. Nusa, meanwhile, plays for Leipzig and was also approached in the last transfer window, while Kvernadze, a 23-year-old Georgian, is making his mark in Serie A with Frosinone. The winger is therefore Roma’s priority heading into January. Three names are on the table, with the management working to identify the right player to hand over to Gasperini ahead of the second half of the season.

item.title: ‘He really changed my life’-Travis Hunter stands by Deion Sanders amid Colorado turmoil
item.description: Photo by Ric Tapia/Getty Images Travis Hunter has delivered a heartfelt message of support for Deion Sanders amid growing questions about the Colorado Buffaloes head coach’s future following a difficult season. The former Colorado star reflected on his recruitment and explained how Sanders changed his outlook on football during an appearance on Ja’Marr Chase’s podcast, Chasing No. 1 . Colorado have endured a challenging campaign, sitting at 2-5 overall after losing five consecutive games and going 0-4 in Big 12 conference play. Travis Hunter explains how Deion Sanders changed his life Hunter revealed that he had initially planned to join Florida State before Sanders intervened and convinced him to choose Colorado. “I was 100% going to Florida State,” Hunter said . Sanders then spoke with Hunter and his family about his vision for the young star, particularly his ambition to play on both sides of the ball. Having played both offence and defence himself, the Pro Football Hall of Famer promised Hunter an opportunity, provided he earned it. “You want to play both sides of the ball? I’m definitely the coach that’s going to—you know, I’ve done it before—but you’re going to have to earn it,” Sanders said, according to Hunter. The Jacksonville Jaguars star made it clear that his respect for Sanders goes far beyond what happened on the football field. “I got too much respect for him,” Hunter added. “He came and got me to not go to Florida State and changed my mindset, changed the picture of everything. He really changed my life for real.” Hunter’s comments come at a difficult time for Sanders, whose Colorado tenure has come under increasing scrutiny following the team’s recent struggles. The Buffaloes finished 3-9 last season and appear to be facing another disappointing campaign. If their current form continues, they could miss out on bowl eligibility for the third time in Sanders’ four seasons as head coach. ESPN’s Matt Barrie has even described Sanders’ Colorado tenure as “as good as done”, although there has been no indication that university officials are ready to part ways with him. For now, Hunter’s comments offer a reminder of the impact Sanders had on one of college football’s biggest stars. Whether the Buffaloes can turn their season around will be crucial as questions about the coach’s future continue. Since Dave Doeren’s firing from NC State football , Philip Rivers ’ name has surfaced more frequently than anyone else’s as a potential replacement for the program’s all-time winningest head coach. Now, the Wolfpack are reportedly narrowing their focus on the former NFL quarterback as they look to find their next leader following Doeren’s departure. According to a report from On3, Rivers has emerged as the primary target in NC State’s coaching search. “NC State legend and former NFL QB Philip Rivers has emerged as the focus of the Wolfpack’s coaching search. With Rivers finishing out the high school season in Alabama, sources tell On3 there is no timetable for his hiring,” the report read. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) NC State decided to part ways with Doeren following a disappointing start to the 2026 season. Doeren spent 14 seasons leading the Wolfpack before they dismissed him following a loss to Stanford. While conversations about a possible return to NC State continue to gain momentum, Rivers remains focused on his current responsibilities as the head coach of St. Michael Catholic High School in Alabama. He has been leading the program since 2021 and is now in his sixth season with the team. Meanwhile, after his team’s regular-season finale against Foley, Rivers provided a more direct response to the growing speculation about a potential return to his alma mater. “There is nothing there at this point,” Rivers said. “You understand the chatter that is out there. You take it one day at a time. I’m excited about this postseason with these guys. Like I said last year, you never say never, but there is nothing imminent.” Rivers has a deep-rooted connection with the Wolfpack, having played for the program from 2000 to 2003. Throughout his college career, he established himself as one of the most accomplished quarterbacks in NC State history. Now, a return to Raleigh could mark a new chapter in his football career. item.title: Clemens keeps playoff hopes alive in wild win over Pieper
item.description: Clemens' Eli Williams runs on the field at Rutledge Stadium in Converse, Texas on Friday, Sept. 18, 2026. (Katina Zentz/San Antonio Express-News) Clemens won its fourth District 28-6A game in a row and kept its playoff hopes alive by winning a 52-49 shootout over Pieper on Friday at Warrior Stadium. Devin Morgan scored the game winning touchdown for Clemens on a 1-yard run with just over two minutes remaining and the Buffaloes came up with two defensive stops in the final minute and a half, including an interception by Zarion Jordan. With the win, Clemens (7-2 overall, 4-2 District 28-6A) moved into a three-way tie for second with Pieper (5-4, 4-2) and Judson (4-4, 4-2) with one week left in the regular season. For Clemens to make its first playoff appearance in seven years, it needs to beat their rival Steele (6-1-1, 5-0), which has already clinched the district championship, Thursday at 7 p.m. at Lehnhoff Stadium. If the Buffaloes lose, they will need some outside help. Pieper finishes the regular season against Wagner (2-6, 1-5) next Friday at Rutledge Stadium and could clinch a playoff berth with a win. The Clemens winning streak started after losing their first two district games to Judson (51-41) and East Central (47-20). After his team's thrilling win over Pieper, Clemens coach Alan Hill wasn't focused on the scenarios for the Buffaloes making the playoffs. Hill was taking in the moment after getting a Gatorade bath from his team after the win. "It was huge," Hill said. "It has been a while. We clinched the first winning season last week (against Wagner) since 2019. That was huge. Obviously, we lost the wrong games early in district play so we still got some work to do or help (to get into playoffs) and we know that. It was a huge win, not just for our program and community, but just how hard our kids have been working, fighting and staying together. "I mean it says a lot about the character of the kids to climb out of an 0-2 hole in district play and reel off four in a row and not quit on their teammates and just go back to work and fight," Hill added. Clemens was led by sophomore running back Daniel Gray, who bullied his way through the Pieper defense for 90 yards rushing and three touchdowns, and by quarterback Carter Menchke, who threw two scoring passes. "We needed this one," Gray said. "Our playoff chances have gone up like a rocket." Gray said has confidence in his squad as they take on Steele next. "It's not impossible," Gray said. "I know some guys over there, they look pretty good but it's not impossible. We just proved that we can go toe-to-toe with any team including even if they are ranked higher than us." The Buffaloes were able to overcome the performance of Pieper quarterback Lance Reid, who went 21-of-31 for 246 yards and four touchdowns, and Pieper receiver Cade Diamond, who finished with 98 yards receiving and three scoring receptions. item.title: 'Chasing big totals is good for cricket': Sanath Jayasuriya
item.description: MUMBAI: Sri Lankan batting great Sanath Jayasuriya has given a thumbs-up to the recent trend of teams chasing down big totals on flat pitches in white-ball cricket. Sri Lanka pulled off the second-highest successful chase in ODIs when they overhauled England's 429-run total in a Tri-Series match in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, on October 22. "It's very good to see that it's happening and players are getting runs on the board and chasing it, which is good for cricket. Teams and players are getting more and more confident, and that is the key. Anything is possible these days, and it is good to see that teams are putting runs on the board and even chasing, but I can see that is also putting the bowlers under pressure," Jayasuriya told reporters at an event on Friday. "It's been a lot of changes in the rules. New things have come up in cricket with new regulations, which are good for the game," he added. Asked about the supremely talented and explosive Abhishek Sharma, who smashed a 38-ball 113, including a 35-ball century, to help India win the third T20I at Wellington by six wickets, Jayasuriya said, "He has a long way to go, but it is a good future for India. Let him play his natural game and let him do his work, and it will be a good investment for Indian cricket." "He (Abhishek) is an all-round player. You cannot say anything in specific is strong — he is an all-round player. He can play in any part of the park, so that is a good thing," he added. Praising India's white-ball team, Jayasuriya said, "They are talented cricketers and are playing well. India has got the talent and is playing good cricket at the moment. There are quite a few Indian players who have been doing well. Good to see them. They are talented, work hard and are playing well." Asked about Sri Lanka's impressive performance in Pakistan in the Tri-Series — they won two of their four matches and qualified for the final, where they will face Pakistan on Saturday — Jayasuriya felt that the campaign would boost their confidence ahead of their white-ball tour of India in December. "It's a good confidence (booster) for the Sri Lankan team, which is doing well before they come to India. The confidence is high, they are playing well, and I hope they will do well in India too," the former dashing left-hander, who also served as Sri Lanka's chief selector, said. Jayasuriya backed India to do well in the forthcoming ODI and Test series in New Zealand. "They are going to do well for sure, but away from India they have always looked to do well, and it will be a good series," he said.

item.title: Messiah Hampton Arrest: Why Was Oregon WR Arrested Ahead of Northwestern Matchup?
item.description: Dan Lanning Oregon © Reuters The Oregon Ducks will be without wide receiver Messiah Hampton for Saturday’s game against the Northwestern Wildcats. The Los Angeles Lakers dropped their rematch against the Golden State Warriors in the first night of NBA Cup play. But it wasn’t because of Luka Doncic. Doncic finished Friday night’s game inside Chase Center with 37 points, seven rebounds, five assists, two blocked shots, and one steal in 37 minutes of play. Doncic did shoot just 12-of-27 from the field and 6-of-16 from three in the Lakers loss. The Lakers got off to a hot start, leading the Warriors 40-15 early in the second quarter after Luka Doncic recorded 21 points in the opening period. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) In fact, Doncic’s first quarter statline of 21 points, five assists, one steal, and one block is actually the first time in the play-by-play era that a player recorded those numbers in a single quarter of an NBA game. The Warriors didn’t stop there, pouring it on in the second half and winning by 17 points, 112-95. NBA Cup play factors in point differential, so it’ll be interesting to see how the Lakers bounce back from this opening loss of NBA Cup play. The Lakers and Warriors are in Group C, which includes Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs, Domantas Sabonis and the Sacramento Kings, as well as Deni Avdija and the Portland Trail Blazers. item.title: Real Madrid face complete La Liga broadcast blackout in China as Mbappe controversy deepens
item.description: Real Madrid face complete La Liga broadcast blackout in China as Mbappe controversy deepens Real Madrid’s excellent performances on the pitch in recent weeks have been overshadowed by the growing controversy involving Kylian Mbappe and China. What began as a comment made in jest by the French forward has now escalated into a serious commercial problem. According to Mundo Deportivo , both major broadcasters holding La Liga rights in China have imposed restrictions in the aftermath of the controversy. However, while Barcelona and other Spanish clubs will retain some television coverage, Real Madrid matches are set to face a complete blackout. Real Madrid face tougher restrictions than La Liga rivals China Media Group, which operates state broadcaster CCTV, has temporarily suspended coverage of the entire league. The broadcaster also rejected the initial apologies from both Mbappe and Real Madrid, deeming them insufficient given the content. “We will listen to their words, but we will watch their actions much more closely,” an unnamed representative explained. Kylian Mbappe finds himself embroiled in the controversy with China. (Photo by Mateo Villalba Sanchez/Getty Images) Meanwhile, Migu, the China Mobile subsidiary holding La Liga broadcasting rights until 2030, has adopted a different approach. The platform intends to continue broadcasting the whole competition, except for matches involving Real Madrid. As a result, Barcelona and the remaining La Liga clubs will retain coverage in China through Migu. Mbappe controversy creates serious commercial concerns The dispute began after Mbappe referred to a meme comparing him to former Chinese leader Mao Zedong, describing the figure as a dictator. Despite subsequently apologising, the Madrid forward has already lost three Chinese sponsorship agreements. La Liga president Javier Tebas also intervened, meeting China’s ambassador to Spain in an attempt to resolve the situation. Javier Tebas tried to resolve the conflict between La Liga and China. (Photo by Arnold Jerocki/Getty Images For Sportel) For Real Madrid, the implications extend beyond Mbappe’s personal endorsements. The club holds a percentage of the player’s image rights, meaning they are also affected financially. Although the precise financial damage remains unclear, prolonged restrictions could weaken Madrid’s commercial presence in China. The club has already expressed its respect for Chinese supporters, but the situation has continued to escalate with no end in sight. Real Madrid will hope to find a resolution to this situation sooner rather than later and restore their diplomatic and commercial relationships with China.

item.description: MUMBAI: India women's team batter Jemimah Rodrigues has recovered from a hamstring injury that had kept her out of action for three months and has joined the Mumbai team in Pune for the ongoing Senior Women's T20 Elite domestic tournament. "For us [at Bayern Munich] it's not just Bayern versus Dortmund," said Kasper, emphasizing just how critical Saturday's game is during a media round which was attended by Bulinews.com amongst others. You have had El Classico [FC Barcelona vs. Real Madrid in La Liga], which everyone knows for decades, and we are as strong as the El Classico. "It's the biggest game of the season and we play it twice a season. But also you see it's not just big in Germany [that it's a popular game] but also internationally too. "The viewership is double the amount of a standard Bundesliga Topspiel game [on Saturday evening]. So there is really big focus on this match because the two strongest teams are playing against eachother," he said. item.title: “We’ll Never Be Washed Bruh”: LeBron James Fans Amped After Sixers Star Scores Dagger in First 20-Point Game of the Season in Win vs. Knicks
item.description: LeBron James dominated 76ers win over Knicks © X/ @sixers LeBron James’ uneven start to his Philadelphia 76ers career in year 24 left fans wondering whether Father Time had finally caught up. His numbers tanked across the board, and he hadn’t had a game where fans were confident he could do what they’d been accustomed to seeing for nearly two and a half decades. James averaged 15.5 points, 6.5 rebounds, and 6.8 assists. He shot 42.6% from the field, 23.1% from the 3-point line, and 61.9% from the free-throw line in his first four games. His points-per-game production and 3-point and free-throw shooting splits are his career-worst marks. James’ field goal shooting clip is his worst since his rookie year. The belief about James losing his edge only grew after Jalen Slawson blocked him on a chase-down and Andrew Nembhard snapped his ankles the same night the Sixers beat the Pacers 114-109 on Wednesday. However, James turned back the clock on Friday against the New York Knicks and produced his best performance of the year in a 98-93 win. The four-time MVP scored 20 points, grabbed nine rebounds and dished eight assists. James shot 8-for-15 and hit the dagger with 12 seconds left to put the Sixers up five. James also hit a tough fadeaway jumper to give Philly a one-point lead with 1:10 left. LeBron James’ fans didn’t miss the chance to clap back at critics who believed the Sixers star might be done. “Did this after all the washed edits and memes. Plus he hit a clutch shot in the 4th. We’ll never be washed bruh,” one fan said. Even Skip Bayless lauds LeBron James’ fit with the Sixers Skip Bayless has been a renowned LeBron James critic. However, even the veteran sports analyst couldn’t help but praise James’ fit and performance against the Knicks. “Sixers continue to show they’re just better than the champs. Held Knicks to 93. No JB, but LeBron had a strong game: 20/9/8, nice lane fadeaway w 1:10 left and late follow. He’s fitting in not out,” Bayless wrote on X. The Sixers improved to 2-0 against the defending NBA champions after also taking care of business at MSG in the season opener. On Friday, the Sixers did it without 2024 NBA Finals MVP Jaylen Brown. Tyrese Maxey also shone with 27 points on 52.6% shooting, while Anfernee Simons scored 21 off the bench, going 5-for-8 from deep. item.title: MotoGP Malaysian GP: Pedro Acosta beats Marc Marquez in tense sprint
item.description: Motorsport photo Pedro Acosta claimed his second career sprint victory with a win for KTM in an edgy Saturday race at Sepang. World championship leader Marc Marquez extended his advantage over the absent Jorge Martin to 19 points by taking second place. It was an intriguing contest, with ever-present rain drops threatening to gain in severity at any time. Several riders further down the pack did in fact gamble on changing bikes in the hopes that the rain might intensify - but the serious downpour only came when the riders were celebrating afterwards. That it was Acosta with the gold medal around his neck had much to do with polesitter Alex Marquez crashing out of the lead on the third tour of the Sepang circuit. Having grabbed the initiative at the first corner, the Gresini Ducati rider had looked in control of proceedings until that point. Alex's departure left Ai Ogura at the head of the field, but with only a narrow advantage over Acosta, Marc Marquez and Marco Bezzecchi. Ogura had earlier worked his way ahead of the first two in an aggressive run through the opening two corners of the race. The Dutch Grand Prix winner was only able to hold the lead until lap eight, however. That's when Acosta made his move. Stubborn defence by Ogura ultimately also allowed Marquez to take second, with Bezzecchi demoting the Japanese rider to fourth a lap later. Acosta hung on for the win ahead of his 2027 factory Ducati team-mate, who could be satisfied with nine points after injured title rival Jorge Martin withdrew from proceeedings earlier in the day. Acosta now has a brace of sprint wins to his name, with the other also coming in Asia, at the season opener in Thailand. He broke his Sunday race duck when he won the Austrian Grand Prix a few weeks ago. For much of the race, fifth place was an all-Italian battle between Francesco Bagnaia, Fabio Di Giannantonio and Enea Bastianini. But late in proceedings, Di Giannantonio made it past Bagnaia and Bastianini dropped back to ninth spot. That left Brad Binder and Diogo Moreira, who racily progressed eight and six spots from their grid positions respectively, to take seventh and eighth. item.title: ‘I’m just having fun’- Stephen Curry reacts to viral Luka Doncic ankle-breaker
item.description: Photo by Ezra Shaw/Getty Images Stephen Curry has reacted after sending Luka Doncic to the floor with a stunning crossover before knocking down a three-pointer during the Golden State Warriors’ 112-95 comeback win over the Los Angeles Lakers. The Warriors star produced one of the standout moments of their NBA Cup opener, leaving Doncic struggling to stay on his feet midway through the third quarter. Curry, who finished with 31 points, six assists and four rebounds, admitted he did not expect the move to look quite so spectacular. Stephen Curry explains his reaction after embarrassing Luka Doncic Speaking after the game, Curry explained that he was simply looking to create some room before the crossover caught everyone by surprise. “I was just trying to get a little bit of space. I didn’t expect it to get that n****,” Curry said. “But it was one of those [where] you gotta kind of keep your composure.” The 38-year-old appeared just as surprised as everyone watching, putting both hands on his head after sinking the three-pointer before running back on defence. Curry also referenced James Harden’s famous celebration, admitting he had not found himself with that much space to shoot in quite some time. “I remember James Harden had to do like the shimmy to get himself going back in the day,” he added. “I don’t know, I haven’t been that open in a long time.” However, the highlight was only one part of a remarkable night for Golden State, who recovered from a 25-point deficit to claim a 17-point victory. Doncic had given the Lakers a commanding start, scoring 21 points in the opening quarter as Los Angeles raced into a 38-15 lead. The Warriors responded with an identical second-quarter score to level the game by half-time before taking control after the break. Curry’s performance also saw him move past Dominique Wilkins into 18th place on the NBA’s all-time scoring list. Despite the viral moment, the Warriors veteran made it clear that his enjoyment of basketball remains the biggest priority as his career progresses. “I just love this game,” Curry said. “All my mannerisms are just all over the place because I’m just having fun.” “Those moments, especially at this stage of your career, you’re just appreciative of the ability to keep playing at this level. And I want that joy to continue until I’m done.” Golden State have now recorded three consecutive wins after opening the season with three straight defeats, giving Curry and his team fresh momentum as their NBA Cup campaign continues.
